speakers.name: Karen Palmer
speakers.role: Immersive artist, futurist and storyteller from the future
speakers.summary: Creating emotionally responsive stories that expose bias and return agency to the participant.
speakers.question: How do we move from being measured by intelligent systems to actively shaping the futures those systems make possible?

speakers.name: Kambale Musavuli
speakers.role: Congolese strategist, technologist and political analyst
speakers.location: Democratic Republic of Congo / United States
speakers.summary: Connecting Africa’s past to its possible futures and asking who owns the systems built from its labour and resources.
speakers.question: How can Africa shape a technological future that does not reproduce the systems of extraction that have defined its past?

speakers.name: Mophat Okinyi
speakers.role: Data worker organiser and global advocate
speakers.summary: Making the invisible labour behind artificial intelligence visible, organised and impossible to ignore.
speakers.question: What changes when the people training AI become organised authors of its future rather than an invisible workforce?
